messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "drink 8 to 10 full glasses of fluid every day to reduce risk of kidney stones"
set: ["drink 8 to 10 full glasses of fluid every day to reduce risk of kidney stones", "drink plenty of fluids to reduce risk of dehydration", "kidney stones", "recurrent kidney stones", "follow special diet to help prevent kidney stones", "reducing risk of kidney function decline", "reduce cardiovascular risk", "your prescriber might reduce your dose of insulin or sulphonylureas if needed to reduce the risk of hypoglycemia", "starting dose and escalation schedule designed to reduce risk of gastrointestinal side effects", "symptoms of fluid retention", "build-up of fluid (edema)", "8 mg twice a day every 12 hours", "risk of overdose", "risk of addiction", "risk of death", "7 to 8 hours"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
